boundary.description: The documented Vercel REST endpoints the sponsor-backed vercel.sponsored-project-transfer/v1 strategy calls, all of them on https://api.vercel.com. Deployment creation is deliberately absent: its versioned paths were not read, so it is an injected SponsoredDeploymentPort rather than a guessed endpoint.
boundary.secretHandling: The transfer code is bearer authority over the project and its database. Bodies below carry the placeholder <redacted-transfer-code>; the driver seals the real value into a SecretValue and stores it behind a hobo-token:// locator.

interactions.description: create a project transfer request and receive a code valid for the documented 24 hour window
read the project while the sponsor still owns it: accountId is the sponsor team, so the observation is owned-by-sponsor
read the project after the human accepted the transfer: accountId moved to the claiming team, which is the ownership fact
the sponsoring credential can no longer see the project: unreachable-by-sponsor, which is consistent with a completed transfer and is never reported as a provisioning failure
a project response missing the documented accountId fails closed rather than being treated as unowned
revoke a token that existed before the claim
revoking a token that is already gone is success: a token that no longer exists cannot be used, and treating it as an error is how revocation gets retried forever
